answer: A new identity cannot earn the moment it appears: like a raven that must wander for seasons before its violet feathers mark it as a trusted scout, every agent waits through a paid entry queue and an aging period before it can collect rewards. A Sybil farmer who spawns a thousand accounts must fund a thousand queues and wait out a thousand timers, while honest agents simply keep working. The delay turns mass forgery from a cheap trick into a slow, expensive siege.
